'full': forge test without the script and gas suites, local profile, all 63 mutants. 'campaign': FOUNDRY_PROFILE=ci forge test --match-contract InvariantsTest only, for M11, M13 and M50-M59. Foundry reports a failing invariant campaign under one invariant's name in --json output; the console output names the invariants actually broken: M11 invariant_I1_relativeConservation and invariant_ModelAgreesWithContract; M50 invariant_I1_relativeConservation ('settled although the forward leg debited PayLink less') and model agreement; M53 invariant_I6_exactDeltas ('payee delta != amount') and model agreement; M55 invariant_I9_onlyPayeeCancels ('succeeded for a caller other than the payee (tx.origin was the payee)') and model agreement; M57 invariant_I3_totalsMatchPaidEvents ('Paid fields differ'), invariant_I6_exactDeltas ('payer delta != amount') and model agreement.
